topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: So, here we are, at the café where we first met, only this time I'm staring at an untouched coffee because she's got some big news to drop. "I’m moving," she says, like it’s just another day. Just another day my entire world shifts without warning. She’s going to be out there in the middle of nowhere, and I’ll be here, left to figure out what to do with a friendship that suddenly feels a thousand miles wide. Well, she’s happy, and that's supposed to be all that matters, right? Except, I can't help but wonder how we’re supposed to keep this up. Setting up calls and sending texts won’t cut it when we can’t just meet up, grab a coffee, and laugh about our days. This is supposed to be a celebration, but all I feel is this tightness, this knot that won’t let me breathe.
